update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.25 - Smarter rank projection
Fixed ----- - The final-rank projection is now recency-weighted, so it tracks a run's accelerating trajectory (slow early, steep in Senior as bonds max and rainbows/spirit bursts land) instead of being dragged down by slow early turns. This fixes the projected grade reading far too low mid-run, and makes projection-driven Auto-Abandon much more reliable (it no longer risks abandoning a healthy run on an overly pessimistic early estimate).
